market_summary: The pre-market setup is cautious to risk-off, based on 802 articles from Yahoo Finance, CNBC Markets, Investing.com, TradingView, The Motley Fool. The dominant theme is macro, with 362 macro items, 208 company items, 213 industry items, and 19 policy items. The tape looks more useful for identifying near-term rotation and risk appetite than for making a single directional index call.
macro_summary: Late Cycle Slowdown Markets are balancing easier policy expectations against growth and earnings risk, keeping leadership narrow and confirmation dependent. The market is taking its direction from oil/energy, with investors testing whether policy support can offset slower growth and earnings risk. Macro coverage is concentrated around inflation (82), oil/energy (67), Fed/rates (34), growth/jobs (11). The practical implication is that equity rallies may need confirmation from rates and inflation expectations; if yields rise while growth headlines weaken, risk appetite can fade quickly.
risk_summary: Sentiment is cautious to risk-off: 52 positive, 174 negative, and 576 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
